input.quote: 11.1 Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
input.rationale: Sections 11.2 and 11.3 already provide machine-readable data return within thirty days and certified deletion, but Section 11.1 contradicts them and sits at our walk-away position: assistance stops immediately on termination, Customer Data is permanently deleted, and export/migration support is expressly excluded. Section 10.1 also assumes an "agreed transition period" that nothing in the document supplies. We therefore replaced 11.1 with up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates and subordinated any deletion to the 11.2/11.3 return-and-certification process, reaching the preferred position with a single-paragraph edit; ninety days is the available fallback.

proposal.summary: Replace immediate cessation/deletion in 11.1 with up to six months of priced transition assistance
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We replaced the immediate cut-off and deletion of Customer Data with up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, which works with the existing data-return and certified-deletion steps in Sections 11.2 and 11.3 and the transition period contemplated by Section 10.1. If six months is difficult, we can accept ninety days as a fallback.

ops.oldText: 11.1 Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
ops.newText: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance, including export and migration support, for up to six months after the effective date of expiry or termination at Vendor's then-current rates. Vendor shall not discontinue assistance or delete Customer Data except in accordance with Sections 11.2 and 11.3.
